answer: Duplicate identities collapse into one because a single attestation cannot back two bonds, and copying another agent's lotus-sealed credential triggers slashing that burns the full stake. Each agent stakes a sable bond locked to a unique proof-of-humanity attestation, and every epoch the network takes a pulse check: agents must submit fresh liveness proofs signed with their bonded key. Faking N identities thus costs N real bonds plus forfeiture, making sybil farming economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
